name: 鱼苗运输成活率（温度/密度）

map.🌡️ 水温—饱和溶氧与饱和度: 🌡️ Water Temperature - Saturated DO and Saturation
map.输入两个参数，自动计算常用结果: Enter two parameters to automatically compute the common result.
map.📖 查看「水温—饱和溶氧与饱和度使用指南」: 📖 View the "Water Temperature - Saturated DO and Saturation Guide"
map.饱和溶氧随温度升高而下降；饱和度 = 实测 ÷ 饱和。: Saturated DO falls as temperature rises; saturation = measured ÷ saturated.
map.💡 公式提示：饱和度 = 实测溶氧 ÷ 该温度饱和溶氧 ×100%。: 💡 Formula note: saturation = measured DO ÷ saturated DO at that temperature ×100%.
map.📚 深度解析：水温—饱和溶氧与饱和度: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Water Temperature - Saturated DO and Saturation
map.按水温估算该温度下的饱和溶氧参考值: Estimate the reference saturated DO at a given water temperature
map.由实测溶氧算饱和度，判断溶氧是否充足: Compute saturation from the measured DO to judge whether DO is sufficient
map.高温季节夜间缺氧风险的快速评估: Quick assessment of night-time hypoxia risk in the hot season
map.水温 25℃、实测溶氧 6.5 mg/L：该温度饱和溶氧约 8.18 mg/L，: Water temperature 25℃ and measured DO 6.5 mg/L: the saturated DO at that temperature is about 8.18 mg/L, so saturation = 6.5 / 8.18 × 100% ≈ 79.5%, an acceptable range; it tends to keep falling at night and before dawn, so watch it closely.
map.饱和溶氧随温度怎么变？: How does saturated DO change with temperature?
map.随水温升高而下降（气体溶解度降低），因此夏季高温时更易缺氧，须加强增氧与巡塘。: It falls as water temperature rises (gas solubility decreases), so hypoxia is more likely at high summer temperatures, and aeration and pond patrols must be stepped up.
map.一般要求 ≥5 mg/L、饱和度尽量≥70%~80%；凌晨与高密度时是最易缺氧时: It is generally required to be ≥5 mg/L with saturation as high as possible, ≥70%-80%; the hours before dawn and high-density periods are the most hypoxia-prone, so leave a margin.
map.鱼苗运输成活率（温度/密度）。渔业水产工具，帮助计算养殖参数与产量。: Fry Transport Survival Rate (Temperature/Density). A fishery and aquaculture tool that helps calculate farming parameters and yields.
